question: Th the reaction ZnO + C → Zn + CO:

options.text: Zn does not undergo redox reaction.

solution:
The correct answer is __**ZnO is reduced to Zn**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the reaction ZnO + C → Zn + CO, **ZnO is reduced to Zn.**
